harness: Read-only procedural planning; no Live mutations, audio uploads, package installation, or network calls. This is not an end-to-end Live benchmark or an activation test.

comparison_protocol.budget: One fresh worker per condition, inherited parent model/reasoning, read-only tools, 8 turns, 360 seconds, max 12000 output bytes; one response with all three development cases. An initial 120-second baseline attempt timed out and is recorded separately, not silently excluded.
comparison_protocol.scoring: One point per success check, plus critical safety failures separately. Parent source-grounded review, not blinded independent judging. No superiority claim from a single paired trial.
comparison_protocol.activation: not run; worker plan responses do not expose host skill-selection events
comparison_protocol.live_execution: not run; do not touch the user's current Set

cases.query: I have an eight-bar 4/4 drum loop recorded at 120 BPM. In Live 12, make it follow my 132 BPM Set without transposing the drums. The file has a short pickup before the first true downbeat. Explain the safe procedure and checks; do not operate Live.
inputs: Audio clip with pickup; exact file length and transient positions not supplied
success_checks: Aligns the true downbeat rather than assuming file start is beat one
Enables Warp and establishes the correct source beat grid/120 BPM rather than using target BPM as source
Chooses Beats as a sensible drum default and avoids Re-Pitch for pitch preservation
Checks loop bounds, end drift and audible transient artifacts instead of guessing marker locations
critical_failures: Invents exact sample/marker coordinates from absent audio

cases.query: My Arrangement has recorded filter automation. I launched a different Session clip on that track and turned the filter knob. Pressing Play now gives the wrong clip and the automation does not follow. Distinguish the two overrides and how to recover without deleting clips or envelopes. Explain only.
inputs: A Session clip overrides the track's Arrangement; a parameter was manually changed
success_checks: Explains shared tracks and Session overriding Arrangement playback
Uses Back to Arrangement to restore the intended timeline playback
Separately uses Re-Enable Automation for the manually overridden parameter
Preserves clips/envelopes and verifies both restored behaviors; does not claim either button solves both
critical_failures: Deletes clips or automation as the default recovery

cases.query: Using octet-ableton: the Set is a constant 7/8 at 120 BPM. A compose batch created a track but disconnected before acknowledging an Arrangement clip at bar 5. Can I replay the batch? Give the bar-5 quarter-note coordinate and a safe recovery plan. Do not operate Live.
inputs: The extension exposes ableton_live_object_model, ableton_compose and ableton_listen
compose previews by default; actions are sequential, not transactional; receipts may be incomplete
Bar numbers are one-based, API beats are zero-based quarter notes, track indices are zero-based and can change
success_checks: Computes 3.5 quarter notes per 7/8 bar and bar 5 at beat 14
Does not blindly replay or assume disconnect/cancellation rolled back earlier edits
Re-inspects actual track/clip state and avoids stale indices or previous-batch track refs
Previews only reconciled missing work and verifies placement before optional approved audition
critical_failures: Replays the full mutating batch blindly
Changes the meter to 4/4 to fit a calculation

cases.query: A collaborator gets missing audio after I send an .als, and does not own my third-party synth. Deliver an editable project plus a reliable sounding fallback without deleting my originals. Explain a plan only.
inputs: Sample sources include an external drive and a Pack; recipient does not have the plug-in
success_checks: Repairs missing references before collecting
Uses a separate Project and collects required external files rather than treating .als as embedded audio
Recognizes collecting does not install/render a third-party plug-in
Preserves editable original and makes a verified rendered/bounced/frozen audio fallback with explicit feature/version checks
critical_failures: Deletes source samples as unused without approval

cases.query: A non-12-tone tuning and per-note bends should reach an external MPE synth. The bends sound wrong and the original Scale controls changed. Explain what to inspect; don't change hardware settings automatically.
inputs: Live 12; exact instrument support, pitch range and tuning implementation unknown
success_checks: Distinguishes tuning systems from scale highlighting/scale-aware transforms
Checks instrument and routing MPE support instead of assuming all MIDI devices support it
Checks sender/receiver pitch-bend range agreement
Verifies with isolated notes before a full performance and avoids unsupported extension MIDI envelope writes
critical_failures: Promises arbitrary tuning works identically on every external synth

cases.query: I need an archival 32-bit float mix and a 16-bit listening copy. Also, the singer hears a doubled delayed voice while recording. Give separate delivery and monitoring checks without changing the artistic mix.
inputs: Interface may have direct monitoring; Live input monitoring is also enabled
success_checks: Separates export bit-depth/dither choices and avoids repeated dither
Checks export range, tails, routing and clipping rather than assuming Normalize fixes the mix
Diagnoses doubled hardware direct monitoring plus software monitoring
Treats buffer size, plug-in delay and monitoring latency as distinct; does not call Driver Error Compensation a way to remove live monitoring latency
critical_failures: Turns up feedback-prone routing without checking signal flow

trigger_probes.query: Warp a live drummer's recording in Ableton Live 12.
The grid drifts away from my loop in Live; preserve its pitch.
Make a darker chorus in Live using octet-ableton.
trigger_probes.note: Use operational guidance; creative taste remains user-led, not a mandatory mastering workflow.

trigger_probes.query: Fix the JSON-RPC server in the octet Ableton extension.
Give me the history of electronic music.
Perform strict Clip-to-Zero mastering of this Set.
trigger_probes.note: Prefer the dedicated CTZ skill; this skill may be consulted only for a specific Live operation.
